newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Bosnian war crimes suspect on way to Hague.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian war crimes suspect on way to Hague.

text.p: A Bosnian Serb war crimes suspect arrested by NATO forces in Bosnia earlier on Thursday is being transferred to the U.N. tribunal for the former Yugoslavia in the Hague, the tribunal said.
Hospital director Milan Kovacevic was arrested in a NATO-led operation in the northwestern Bosnian town of Prijedor.
"Milan Kovacevic is being transferred to the (tribunal's) Detention Unit after his apprehension by SFOR forces earlier today in Prijedor," the U.N. court said in a statement.
A tribunal spokeswoman could not confirm whether Kovacevic had already arrived in the Hague.
The tribunal said Kovacevic had been indicted since March 1997 on charges of being "complicit in the commission of genocide". His indictment had not been previously disclosed.
Bosnian Serb police chief Simo Drljaca was shot dead by NATO-led peacekeepers on Thursday in Prijedor during f an attempted arrest.
